column3: With respect to The Common Place Mortgage Loan (2.5%), the Phase I environmental site assessment obtained in connection with loan origination identified a REC associated with the property’s historical use as a semi-trailer repair facility with known soil and groundwater impacts from petroleum and other volatile organic compound contaminants. Multiple environmental investigations and remediation efforts have been conducted on-site since 2014, including soil excavation and groundwater monitoring. Additionally, a passive sub-slab vapor mitigation system was installed in the building during construction of the subject improvements. In January 2025, indoor air sampling confirmed the mitigation system was functioning as designed. No contaminants of concern were identified above applicable action levels and the passive vapor mitigation system was deemed sufficient. The Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (“WDNR”) granted conditional case closure in 2023 subject to certain continuing obligations, including maintaining soil caps, managing future excavations and maintaining the passive vapor mitigation system. Full closure is pending submission of final documentation to the WDNR. The ESA notes that the REC is not expected to present a risk to residents or occupants of the Property or impede the intended use of the Property and did not recommend further investigation. Once closure is finalized, the site will be classified as a CREC. Pending finalization by the engineer overseeing the project, the loan documents require the borrower to submit the regulatory closure letter to the WDNR.
